description: This script manages iOS development team IDs for code signing, detecting available teams from Xcode preferences, profiles, keychains, and user input. It handles fallback mechanisms and outputs the selected team ID.

methods.name: detect_python
methods.description: Detects a suitable Python interpreter among candidate options.

methods.name: append_team
methods.description: Adds a team ID, free status, and name to internal arrays if not already present.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_preferences
methods.description: Loads team IDs from Xcode's preferences plist using plutil and Python JSON parsing.

methods.name: load_teams_from_legacy_defaults_key
methods.description: Loads team IDs from legacy defaults.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_managed_profiles
methods.description: Extracts team IDs from provisioning profile files.

methods.name: has_xcode_account
methods.description: Checks for the existence of an Xcode developer account.
